newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Gold weighs on Australian stocks at open.
newsitem.headline: Gold weighs on Australian stocks at open.

text.p: Australian shares opened weaker on Tuesday with a depressed gold price weighing on the market and few reasons for local buyers to enter the market.
Gold stocks continued their downward run with the gold index dipping 1.9 percent in early trade. So far in 1997 the industry index has lost 5.4 percent.
The All Ordinaries index lost 5.8 points to 2,404.0.
"There is no reason for it to go ahead today," said a Sydney broker. "The golds are still losing ground and there is little else locally to help."
Early turnover was boosted by a series of pre-opening special trades through SBC Warburg with brokers saying an institutional investor appeared to be shuffling holdings.
Brokers said the outlook was for a slightly weaker finish.
Falls outnumbered rises by a ratio of about two to one, while about 40 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
